title: ASP Client Workspace Search Playbook Request V1
description: The normalized northbound Search request produced from one admitted Scheme composition expression. Code and document producer axes are projected into language and documents; Scheme source and POO implementation objects do not cross this boundary.

workspace.description: Explicit registered cross-workspace identity. Filesystem paths are not workspace identities.

rg.description: Regex acquisition blocks. Search scope is inherited from workspace; argv must not contain a search root.

tantivy.description: Ranked-text acquisition blocks. They are independent unless an admitted composition explicitly intersects them with another carrier-compatible set.

syntax.description: Compiled resident structural query plans. A structural-only request starts directly from the immutable Workspace universe; Tree-sitter Query source does not cross this normalized boundary.

nativeSyntax.description: Exact selector predicates whose singleton matches establish structural scope. Exact materialization remains a Query operation.

composition.description: Payload-free operator tree over normalized clause references. Runtime must execute these explicit operators and must not infer intersection from engine co-presence.

clauseOrder.description: Exact source order of leaves in the admitted V1 composition. Retrieval stages cannot follow a structural stage; Graph is the final barrier.

producerExpression.description: One or more registered producers from the axis named by the enclosing field.
